description: This file defines the SessionLog class responsible for logging responses and user actions during a session, including writing session data to a markdown file and managing log entries with timeout-based flushing.

classes.name: SessionLog
classes.description: A class for managing session logging, including recording responses, user actions, and writing log entries to a markdown file.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new SessionLog instance with a session folder created based on current timestamp.

methods.name: logResponse
methods.description: Logs a response object into the session log.

methods.name: logUserAction
methods.description: Logs a user action along with associated tab and code information.

methods.name: _appendEntry
methods.description: Appends a log entry to the pending entries and sets up a timeout to flush entries.

methods.name: _flushEntries
methods.description: Flushes pending log entries to the session markdown file, formatting entries and handling file writes.
